dataset: HoneyChain Synthetic Indian Hive Telemetry v1.0
research_basis: Krishnasamy et al. 2023, Sociobiology, Apis cerana indica colonies in Bengaluru: in-hive temperature/RH linked to forager activity; strong-colony peak 27.84 C/61.47% RH; weak-colony peak 26.52 C/61.42% RH; brood/honey/pollen areas measured.

Geetha, Theerthagiri & Devi 2025, Indian Journal of Entomology: Andhra Pradesh apiary; temperature, humidity, hive weight, vibration and sound were among monitored parameters; raw public observations were not found in the accessible source.
synthetic_assumptions: Slow weight trajectories and short-term foraging variation.
Controlled single-parameter and multivariate anomaly scenarios.
warning: Do not report this dataset as real Indian measurements or use synthetic classification accuracy as real-world disease-detection accuracy.
